answer: Use a peer-endorsement graph with decaying reputation: a new agent cannot transact alone until several established, unrelated agents vouch for its completed useful work, and each endorsement fades unless renewed by further verified work. A Sybil operator must therefore maintain a whole river of fake histories, not just create accounts. Old, idle identities become a relic rather than a permanent pass. Forging thousands in parallel multiplies coordination and detection risk, while one exposed cluster can revoke the whole connected graph, like marble cracking along a hidden fault.
